script_text: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, wise men from the East came to Jerusalem, saying, «Where is He who has been born King of the Jews? For we have seen His star in the East and have come to worship Him.» When Herod the king heard this, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him. And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born. So they said to him, «In Bethlehem of Judea, for thus it is written by the prophet: «But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, Are not the least among the rulers of Judah; For out of you shall come a Ruler Who will shepherd My people Israel.»́ Then Herod, when he had secretly called the wise men, determined from them what time the star appeared.

The brush style is painterly, with visible strokes that convey the organic feel of the materials, while textures mimic the roughness of aged surfaces and fabrics. The camera mood is intimate and immersive, drawing viewers into the scenes as if they are part of the unfolding narrative. It’s essential to avoid any modern elements, ensuring that every detail—architecture, clothing, and tools—reflects the historical context without anachronisms. The focus remains on the events and interactions within the setting, steering clear of any textual elements or representations of books.
